info.name: Open Exchange Rates Convert Historical Rates API
Get historical exchange rates for a date

params.name: date
params.description: The requested date in YYYY-MM-DD format (UTC).

params.name: base
params.description: Change the base currency to which all rates are relative, as a 3-letter currency code. Defaults to USD. Changing the base currency requires a paid plan.

params.name: symbols
params.description: Limit results to specific currencies as a comma-separated list of 3-letter currency codes.

params.name: show_alternative
params.description: Set to true to extend returned values with alternative, black market, and digital currency rates.

params.name: prettyprint
params.description: Set to true for human-readable response formatting.

items.docs: Returns the end-of-day exchange rates for a given UTC date, currently going back to January 1st, 1999. Rates are the final published values for the day through 23:59:59 UTC; requesting the current UTC date returns the most recent rates (matching latest.json). Base currency and symbols filtering are available on the Developer, Enterprise, and Unlimited plans.
